name: rivethub-grokbot
description: RivetHub mesh member kit for Grok Bot: shared memory MCP/skills, mesh delegation helpers, and stranger onboarding (cloud vs local DataHub).

RIVETOS_MODE.title: RivetOS mode
RIVETOS_MODE.description: Where memory/mesh traffic goes. cloud = RivetOS cloud account. local = Tailscale + your DataHub. Leave unset to fall back to ~/.rivetos/.env (house nodes).

RIVETOS_CLOUD_TOKEN.title: RivetOS cloud token (secret)
RIVETOS_CLOUD_TOKEN.description: Tenant / account credential from Rivet Cloud. Never commit or paste into chat. Browser OAuth is not in this kit yet — paste the token from the cloud dashboard or `rivetos cloud connect --token`.

RIVETOS_CLOUD_URL.title: RivetOS cloud URL
RIVETOS_CLOUD_URL.description: Optional override of the default cloud API (https://rivetos.cloud).

RIVETOS_DATAHUB_URL.title: DataHub endpoint
RIVETOS_DATAHUB_URL.description: Local-mode one-field endpoint (MagicDNS or postgres URL). Mapped to RIVETOS_PG_URL when the value is postgres:// or postgresql://.

RIVETOS_PG_URL.title: Postgres URL (secret, legacy)
RIVETOS_PG_URL.description: Direct Postgres URL only if DataHub URL is not enough. Prefer RIVETOS_DATAHUB_URL. Never commit.
